name: Fortio
description: Istio's load testing library and tool with CLI, advanced echo server, and web UI. Supports configurable QPS with latency histogram recording.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker image fortio/fortio; multi-arch support (amd64, arm64, ppc64le, s390x); less than 6MB image

eval_notes: Istio's official load testing tool with tiny Docker image (<6MB). Supports HTTP, gRPC, TCP, and UDP. Built-in echo server and web UI. Multi-protocol support makes it versatile for telecom service mesh evaluation.
